response.justification: Bogdan demonstrates strong full-stack and tooling experience with a focus on developer productivity, but his background lacks direct IDE/JVM tooling expertise. His work on open-source projects and diverse tech stacks shows adaptability, though alignment with enterprise Java/Kotlin ecosystems is limited.
strengths: Proven track record in building and optimizing developer tools (e.g., GISCollective, Fluent-Asserts).
Diverse experience across web, desktop, and embedded systems with a focus on testability and UX.
Strong open-source contributions and community engagement (workshops, talks, and libraries).
concerns: Limited direct experience with Java/Kotlin or enterprise frameworks (Spring, Quarkus).
Most recent roles emphasize TypeScript/Node.js, not JVM-based tooling.
No explicit mention of IDE internals or language tooling in professional history.
